title: totalfloat history revert --json, and history undo --json
description: A changeset taken back out of a branch: the later edits replayed without it, and the new changeset recording the result. Nothing is deleted.

replayed.description: The later changesets replayed without it, oldest first.

recorded.description: The revert changeset; null when the result is the file as it was.

impact.description: What the revert changed, as a totalfloat.diff/1 report from the branch head to the result, or null if it couldn't be compared.
